children: NextTrip launched JOURNY TV and JOURNY Español on LG Channels, expanding distribution to 20 international markets and an estimated 250 million potential viewers.
JOURNY TV now on LG Channels in 14 markets including UK, Canada, Brazil, Germany and Australia.
JOURNY Español launched on LG Channels in six Spanish-speaking markets: Mexico, Peru, Chile, Argentina, Colombia and Spain.
Expansion grows JOURNY’s footprint to more than a dozen major platforms across ~80 countries.
Company estimates potential global reach of approximately 250 million viewers across its distribution ecosystem.
NextTrip is developing JOURNYGO using Agentic AI to link travel content to destination exploration, itinerary building and bookings.
